name: repcheck-js-tests
description: JS test runtime for RepCheck's inline template scripts, plus the Capacitor dependencies for the iOS shell. The web app itself is server-rendered Flask + vanilla JS with no build step -- the Capacitor packages are never bundled into it; they exist so `npx cap sync` can copy the native plugin code into the Xcode project. static/native.js talks to window.Capacitor.Plugins at runtime instead of importing any of them.
